newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Snia BPD '96 cons net profits rise.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Snia BPD '96 cons net profits rise.

text.p: Italian holding group Snia BPD reported on Friday a net consolidated profit for 1996 of 119.7 billion lire after 102.2 billion lire in 1985, with attributable net profits up at 80.1 billion lire from 63.5 billion lire.
At the parent company level, Snia BPD SpA showed a net profit falling to 26.8 billion lire in 1996 from 33.9 billion lire in 1995, said a statement from Snia BPD.

The company proposed an ordinary dividend for 1996 of 60 lire a share from 50 lire in 1995, a dividend on its convertible savings shares of 80 lire a share from 70 lire, and a payout of 90 lire per non-convertible savings shares from 80 lire.
Consoldiated sales of the group rose slightly in 1996 to 2.97 trillion lire from 2.94 trillion lire in 1995, of which 55 percent were made abroad.
Net debt for the group fell to 294.6 billion lire by the end of 1996 from 394 billion lire at end-1995.
